FLASHSCORE PREVIEW

Leaders Paris Saint-Germain will be looking to record a ninth successive win in Ligue 1 against a resilient Lorient side that denied them victory in both H2Hs last season. 

Match News and Current Form

PSG missed the chance to earn a 13th straight victory on Wednesday, drawing 2-2 with Roma in the UEFA Champions League. Heading into this fixture while enjoying the longest ongoing winning run across Europe’s top-five leagues (W8), the Parisians’ strikeforce may have to be top notch to keep that streak going, as their 12 goals conceded at this stage is their most after 11 matchdays since 2009/10. PSG have scored in their last 54 home league games though, and finding the net again here would see them equal the longest such run in France’s top flight in the last 75 years set by any club, although the current sequence did begin following a 0-0 draw with Lorient!

Lorient arrive here in fine form after losing just one of their last six matches (W3, D2), a run which includes a 1-0 win over PSG’s closest challengers and city rivals, Paris FC. Sitting at least five points better off than at the same stage of their last two top-flight seasons, Les Merlus will likely fancy their chances on Saturday having conceded only twice on their Ligue 1 travels this term (W2, D2, L1) - Lorient have kept as many clean sheets in their last six league away trips (five) as they had in their previous 51 such games!

Head-to-Head History

PSG have secured just three victories in the last nine H2Hs (D4, L2) after winning the previous 12. Only Bayern Munich have faced the Parisians as often since the start of 2021 and restricted them to as few wins. 

Win Probability
Opta by StatsPerform
Hot Stats and Streaks

PSG have avoided defeat in all five of their league games when conceding first this season (W3, D2). 

PSG have attempted a Ligue 1-high 207 shots and 83 shots on target this term ahead of this weekend.

Lorient have registered a league-low 112 shots and 31 shots on target this season.

Lorient’s last six games each featured under 2.5 goals. 

Key Players to Watch and Missing Players

Achraf Hakimi continued his fine form from the international window (G2, A1) by getting an assist in PSG’s 3-2 win over Nice last weekend, while his last three Ligue 1 scoring appearances have each seen him find the net at least twice. Aiyegun Tosin equalised for Lorient in their 2-2 draw here last season, contributing to eight of his last nine league goals arriving after half-time. 

Neither side seemingly have any fresh absentees. 

For all the latest team news, please check the Flashscore match centre.

Betting Analysis

Backing a draw could be a great-value selection here given Lorient’s impressive recent H2H record and their away solidity this season.

Author: Matthew Billon
